bloques.titulo: The position two of the verb (Verbzweitstellung)
texto: In German, the order of the elements is flexible, but the conjugated verb is anchored to the **segunda posición**:
**Ich wohne in Berlin.** (Pos. 1: Ich Pos. 2: wohne Pos. 3: in Berlin).
**Carlos kommt aus Spanien.** (Pos. 1: Carlos Pos. 2: kommt Pos. 3: aus Spanien).
If you highlight the place or object at first, the subject passes **inmediatamente detrás del verbo** (position 3), because the verb does not move from position 2:
**In Berlin wohne ich.** (Pos. 1: In Berlin Pos. 2: wohne Pos. 3: ich).
**Aus Spanien kommt Carlos.** (Pos. 1: Aus Spanien - Pos. 2: kommt Pos. 3: Carlos).
**Deutsch sprechen wir in Wien.** (Pos. 1: Deutsch Pos. 2: sprchen Pos. 3: wir).
Eye! In German you can't say «*In Berlin ich wohne*».

frases.de: Hallo, Carlos! Wo wohnst du in Deutschland?
frases.en: Hey, Carlos! Where do you live in Germany?

frases.de: In Berlin wohne ich. Und du?
frases.en: I live in Berlin. And you?

frases.de: Aus Hamburg komme ich. In Berlin arbeite ich auch!
frases.es: De Hamburgo vengo. ¡En Berlín trabajo yo también!
frases.en: I'm from Hamburg. I work in Berlin too!

frases.de: Danke! In Wien sprechen wir Deutsch.
frases.en: Thank you! We speak German at school.

bloques.titulo: Phrases with the verb in second position

bloques.pregunta: If you start a prayer with the place «In Berlin...», where should the conjugated verb «wohne» be placed?

opciones.texto: Inmediatamente después del lugar, en posición 2: «In Berlin wohne ich».
opciones.explicacion: The conjugated verb always occupies position 2 in the main prayer.

opciones.texto: Al final de la frase: «In Berlin ich im Zentrum wohne».
opciones.explicacion: The verb at the end is only used in subordinate prayers.

opciones.texto: Después del pronombre: «In Berlin ich wohne».
opciones.explicacion: In German you cannot keep the subject in front of the verb after a supplement.

bloques.pregunta: Which of the following prayers respect the rule of the verb in position two?

opciones.explicacion: Complete in position 1, verb in position 2 and subject in position 3.
The verb cannot be left in third position.
In an enunciative sentence the verb should be the second element.

bloques.pregunta: In the «In Wien sprechen wir Deutsch» phrase, which element is position 1?

opciones.explicacion: The full prepositional group counts as a single block in position 1.
The prepositions form a syntactic block with its noun.
The pronoun of the subject occupies position 3, after the verb.
It's the form of infinitive or plural.
With the third person singular (Sophie / her) the regular verb ends in -t.
It's the form of infinitive or plural.
Investment: «Deutsch» in position 1, «sprechen» verb in position 2, «wir» subject in position 3.

opciones.texto: We don't speak German in Vienna.

intro: The most important rule of the German syntax is the fixed position of the verb: in every main enunciative prayer, the conjugated verb always goes in second position.
